entry.title: Four Dynasties — The Machine Behind the School
entry.content:
Four interlocking dynasties converge on one charter school enterprise. Each contributed a structural component that makes the machine run:

What Each Dynasty Contributed

DynastyStructural RoleFederal RecordWhat They Gave Banks
Banks/Flenory (BMF)Blood lineageOD Banks: BMF Defendant #22. Tonesa Welch: BMF defendantThe family brand. The extraction playbook. The zero-accountability narrative.
StallworthSocial incubationKeith: $20K gang money laundering (2003)BCF board access → family donations → MacDowell Board President → DPSCD authorization pipeline
SabreeJudicial captureFBI-probed 2019, Bowles class action2 children on the bench covering the enterprise’s courts. Foreclosure pipeline.
KilpatrickPolitical infrastructureKwame: 24 federal RICO feloniesPR machine (Dumas), dark money (Daniels → Detroit Leaders), charter authorization (Gay-Dagnogo), and the brand association (Carolyn at CBC party)

The Structuring Pattern — Two Decades, One Crime

WhoWhenAmountFor WhomMethodSentence
Keith Stallworth1998 (pled 2003)$20,000“A gang”False CTR at Michigan National Bank — hid true ownerPlea deal (conspiracy charges dropped)
Kenneth Daniels2010 (convicted 2014)$19,000Drug kingpin Carlos PowellTwo cashier’s checks at two banks — evaded $10K reporting1 year
Brian Banks2003–2016MultipleHimselfCheck fraud, forgery, financial transaction device, false pretenses≤8 months + 1 day total

Three men. Three structuring schemes. Three barely-there sentences. All three remained active in Detroit politics. All three connected to the same network.

The Powell drug operation that Daniels served: $21 million laundered, 12 kg cocaine, 30 kg heroin, 1,000 lbs marijuana. Both Powell brothers got life. Daniels got one year. Keith Stallworth’s conspiracy charges were dropped. Banks has served less than nine months total across 9 convictions.

The Racial Solidarity Shield

All four dynasties used the same armor: racial solidarity.

The Stallworths ran the Black Caucus Foundation. The Sabrees built a judicial dynasty in the most Black city in America. The Kilpatricks embodied Black political power in Detroit. Banks frames himself as a “redemption story” for a Black community that believes in second chances.

The armor works because it exploits something real. The history of racism against Black Detroiters is not fabricated. The distrust of institutions that have failed Black communities is earned. The desire for Black leadership in Black institutions is legitimate.

But when that legitimate desire is weaponized to protect a man who produces 3% math proficiency — when 97% of overwhelmingly Black children cannot do grade-level math while $4.9 million flows through shell entities — the armor is not protecting the community. It is trapping them inside the machine.

The crack trade destroyed these neighborhoods. The foreclosure pipeline stripped them of wealth. Kwame’s corruption bankrupted their city. And now the children who grew up in that wreckage sit in classrooms run by the same families, at the same addresses, with the same zero-accountability playbook — and they can’t do math.

The machine survived every prosecution. It survived the crack era, the RICO case, the FBI probes, the money laundering pleas. It put on a suit. It moved into the school system. It counts heads for per-pupil funding.

The Convergence Points

Where all four dynasties physically intersected:

VenueWho Was ThereWhat Happened
2023 CBC Party, Grand Hyatt DCBanks (host), Carolyn Cheeks Kilpatrick (honorary host), Nicole Wells-Stallworth (honoree)Party-to-board pipeline: honorees became board members
Black Caucus Foundation of MichiganBanks (board), Keith Stallworth (Managing Dir), Virgil Smith (board), Bert Johnson (board)Reunion of felons — where Banks met the Stallworths
MacDowell Prep, 4201 W Outer DrBanks (superintendent), Wells-Stallworth (Board President), Misha Stallworth West (DPSCD authorizer)Extraction point — $4.9M/yr, 3% math
Wayne County CourthouseJudges Sabree, Sabree, Yancey, Perkins, MillerJudicial capture — enterprise cases land before network judges
DPSCD BoardGay-Dagnogo (authorized PCA), Misha Stallworth West, Corletta VaughnCharter authorization pipeline
Michigan LegislatureBanks, Gay-Dagnogo, Keith Stallworth, Thomas Stallworth III, Kenneth Daniels, Bert JohnsonWhere the political relationships were forged
Banks’ book acknowledgmentsKaren Dumas, Sherry Gay-Dagnogo, Todd PerkinsBanks named them in his own published work

The Intermediaries — Where the Dynasties Meet the Schools

The dynasties provide the infrastructure. But someone has to physically connect the political power to the school operation. These intermediaries are the new family blood — not dynasty heirs, but operators who embedded themselves across multiple institutions in sequence, creating the handoff chains.

Judge Tenisha Yancey — The Bridge ✅ Verified 

JIMMY SETTLES (UAW Vice President)
    └── uncle of
TENISHA YANCEY
    ├── Worked at Wayne County Land Bank (Sabree's domain, 2007-2013)
    ├── Wayne County Exec Office (Evans)
    ├── Wayne County Prosecutor (juvenile)
    ├── Harper Woods Board of Ed (Banks' suburb)
    ├── Succeeded Banks in HD-1 (Nov 2017)
    ├── 36th District Judge (Nov 2022) — same court as Adam Sabree + Sean Perkins
    ├── MacDowell Board Chair
    ├── SOLE campaign activity: $383.82 to Banks' LLC
    ├── Paid son Jaylen $2,935 from campaign
    └── SISTER: Dr. Chalena Yancey Beasley → PCA School Leader

She sat in every institution in sequence: Sabree’s land bank → county government → prosecutor’s office → Banks’ suburban school board → Banks’ legislative seat → the bench → Banks’ school board. Each stop added a layer of institutional access. → Full Yancey Profile

Sherry Gay-Dagnogo — The Golden Parachute ✅ Verified 

GAY-DAGNOGO
    ├── State Rep HD-8 (2015-2020) — overlapped with Banks HD-1
    │   ├── Rallied for Banks at AG charges (2016)
    │   ├── Defended Banks' plea deal (2017)
    │   └── Sought Kwame Kilpatrick clemency (2020)
    │

    │   ├── Authorized PCA charter

    │

        ├── 10-year term, $199,500/year
        ├── Cannot easily be removed
        └── Handles citizen complaints about DPSCD
            └── The complaint system itself is captured

She defended Banks publicly, authorized his school, paid his drug trafficker associate, then took a 10-year appointment running the office that handles complaints about the system she captured. → Full Gay-Dagnogo Profile

Bishop Corletta Vaughn — The Authorization Chair 📄 Documented 

CORLETTA VAUGHN
    ├── DPSCD Board since 2016 (President/VP)
    ├── Authorized PCA + MacDowell charters
    ├── At Banks events (Facebook captures)
    ├── Same board as Gay-Dagnogo + Misha Stallworth West
    └── DISQUALIFIED from 2026 reelection
        └── $950 owed to Wayne County (Sabree's domain)

The DPSCD Board President who authorized Banks’ schools — disqualified from reelection for $950 owed to the same county whose treasurer’s children sit on the network’s courts. → Full Vaughn Profile

entry.title: The Kilpatrick Dynasty — Next Generation Playbook
entry.content:
The Connection

Banks didn’t just operate in Kilpatrick’s shadow — he stepped into it deliberately.

At the 2023 Michigan CBC Party at the Grand Hyatt in Washington, DC, Banks’ honored guests included:

HonoreeTitleSignificance
Carolyn Cheeks KilpatrickFormer U.S. Congresswoman (1997–2011)Kwame Kilpatrick’s mother. Honorary host at Banks’ CBC party.
Nicole Wells-StallworthCEO, The Children’s CenterMacDowell Board Chair — hired Banks
Ric PreussIBEW Local 18Became MacDowell Board Secretary

Banks put Kwame’s mother on his flyer. At his party. In Washington. During Congressional Black Caucus Week. This is not coincidence — it’s a brand statement: I am the next generation of the Kilpatrick machine.

The Kilpatrick Family

PersonRoleFederal Record
Kwame KilpatrickFormer Mayor of Detroit (2002–2008)24 federal felony convictions — RICO, mail fraud, wire fraud, tax fraud, extortion. Sentenced to 28 years. Commuted by Trump (Jan 2021).
Carolyn Cheeks KilpatrickFormer U.S. Congresswoman (MI-13/15), 1997–2011Lost 2010 primary to Hansen Clarke — voters punished her for Kwame’s crimes. Died Oct 7, 2025.
Bernard KilpatrickKwame’s fatherConvicted of filing false tax returns related to Kilpatrick Enterprise proceeds

The Kilpatrick Network Nodes in Banks’ Orbit

1. Karen Dumas — From Kwame’s Comms Chief to Banks’ PR

FieldValue
CompanyImages & Ideas, Inc. (LARA #444077, est. 1991)
Under KwameExecutive Director of Community Relations, Mayor Kilpatrick’s office
Under BingChief of Communications, Mayor Bing
Banks connectionFacebook support for PCA. Social circle overlap. Banks thanks her by name in his book.
CurrentCommunications consultant, Detroit

Karen Dumas went from managing Kwame Kilpatrick’s public image to promoting Brian Banks’ charter school on social media. The job description didn’t change — protect a convicted public official’s reputation — only the client did.

On Kwame’s commutation: “I have long felt that 28 years was just too long. I was glad to see that Donald Trump commuted his sentence.” — Karen Dumas, WDET, Jan 2021

2. Kenneth Daniels — From Kwame Appointee to Dark Money Operator ✅ Verified

FieldValueSource
Former officeMichigan State Rep, District 5 (1999–2004)Ballotpedia
Kwame appointmentDetroit Water & Sewerage Dept BoardDetroit Free Press, Sep 18, 2014
Detroit Board of EdElected member (3 years)Free Press
Federal convictionStructuring $19K in financial transactions for drug kingpin Carlos Powell to buy a $40,000 Mercedes BenzFree Press, HuffPost, DEA
Sentence1 year federal prison (Sep 2014)Free Press
TrialConvicted alongside Carlos Powell, Eric Powell, Earnest Proge Jr.Detroit News, Sep 18, 2014
Powell operation$21 million laundered, 12 kg cocaine, 30 kg heroin, 1,000 lbs marijuanaDEA
Powell sentenceLIFE (both brothers, Oct 2014)Free Press, Oct 17, 2014
2010 Senate raceLost to Bert Johnson — the same seat Banks tried to run for. Johnson later indicted for ghost employeesPublic record
Current roleOfficer, Detroit Leaders (dark money 501(c)(4))Free Press
Dark money effectDetroit Leaders ran money supporting Latisha Johnson (PCA Board Secretary) against ML ElrickTransparencyUSA

The Structuring Pattern

Keith Stallworth (2003): Structured $20,000 through Michigan National Bank to hide drug money. Kenneth Daniels (2014): Structured $19,000 through two banks to buy a drug kingpin a Mercedes.

Different decades. Same crime. Same method. Same network.

Both were former state representatives. Both structured ~$20K for drug operations. Both got minimal sentences. Both remained active in Detroit politics. Both are connected to Brian Banks.

3. Charles Pugh — From Council President to Convicted Sex Offender ✅ Verified

FieldValue
Former officeDetroit City Council President (2009–2013)
Banks connectionReferred Tramaine Cotton to Banks as legislative aide (2013)
Banks settlementState of Michigan paid Cotton ~$12,000 + $85,622 to Dickinson Wright
Criminal convictionCriminal sexual conduct with a minor

Pugh referred Cotton to Banks. Cotton alleged Banks pressured him into sex acts. The state settled. Pugh was later convicted of CSC with a minor. Banks’ referral network runs through convicted sex offenders.

4. Sherry Gay-Dagnogo — From Kwame Clemency to Banks Defense ✅ Verified

FieldValue
CurrentDetroit Ombudsman (10-year term to 2035)
FormerDPSCD Board Member — authorized PCA’s charter
2016Publicly rallied for Banks when AG filed felony charges: “These attacks will not be tolerated”
2017Defended Banks’ plea deal: “For him to have charges for a loan that was paid back is disheartening”
2020Sought Kwame Kilpatrick clemency from Trump at White House

Gay-Dagnogo defended Kwame’s crimes. Then she defended Banks’ crimes. Then she authorized Banks’ charter school. Then she got a 10-year appointment as Detroit Ombudsman — the office that’s supposed to hold city institutions accountable.

The Pattern

KWAME KILPATRICK (24 federal felonies, RICO, pardoned)
│
├── CAROLYN CHEEKS KILPATRICK (mother)
│   └── Honorary host at Banks' 2023 CBC party
│
├── KAREN DUMAS (comms chief → PR)
│   └── Manages Banks' public image via social media
│       Banks thanks her BY NAME in his book
│
├── KENNETH DANIELS (Kwame appointee → drug money structurer)
│   ├── Structured $19K for drug kingpin Carlos Powell
│   ├── Now officer of Detroit Leaders (dark money)
│   └── Detroit Leaders supported Latisha Johnson (PCA Board Secretary)
│       Johnson defeated ML Elrick — the journalist investigating Banks
│
├── CHARLES PUGH (Council President → sex offender)
│   └── Referred Cotton to Banks → sexual harassment → state settlement
│
└── SHERRY GAY-DAGNOGO (Kwame defender → Banks defender → Ombudsman)
    ├── Sought Kwame clemency from Trump (2020)
    ├── Rallied for Banks at AG charges (2016)
    ├── Authorized PCA charter (2025)
    └── Now Ombudsman (10yr term to 2035) — the "accountability" office

Four Dynasties, One Machine

DynastyPatriarch/OriginFederal RecordPipeline to Banks
KilpatrickKwame (Mayor)24 felonies, RICO, pardonedMom at CBC party → Dumas PR → Daniels dark money → Gay-Dagnogo charter authorization
StallworthAlma (State Rep)Keith: $20K gang money launderingBCF board → Nicole hires Banks → Misha authorizes charter
SabreeEric (Treasurer)FBI-probed, Bowles class action2 children on bench → foreclosure pipeline → tax auction self-dealing
Banks/FlenoryOD Banks (BMF)BMF Defendant #22Blood → Tonesa Welch (BMF figure) → enterprise professionalized

The machine survived Kwame’s conviction. It survived the BMF prosecution. It survived Keith Stallworth’s guilty plea. It survived the FBI probing the Sabrees. It put on a suit, moved into the school system, and now extracts $4.9 million in public education dollars while producing 3% math proficiency.

The same communities destroyed by the crack trade, by Kwame’s corruption, by the foreclosure pipeline — those communities’ children now sit in Banks’ classrooms, unable to do basic math, while the machine counts their heads for per-pupil funding.
